description: Active Enyo NNUE improvement-run config. Use this as the reviewed candidate recipe.
goal: Scale the best scratch/qkaiming Enyo-owned baseline from 1M to 2.6M training rows to test whether scratch can approach the current reference without Berserk initialization.

success_condition: training reaches materially better sign/MAE than the 1M scratch run
exported model.nn validates with static eval
failure-suite/move-choice gates do not show catastrophic tails
next_after_success: run static validation against the packed run data
only SPRT if it approaches reference static metrics and gates are clean
